commandQualification: Run from the @beep/repo-cli package directory with the same Node Vitest reporter command shape as the P1 baseline. Raw reporter JSON and the wall-time log are retained in the ignored worktree proof directory.
reporterTotalMsDefinition: max(file.endTime) - reporter.startTime; excludes shutdown and report writing; wholeCommandSeconds measures elapsed process time separately
comparability: Not comparable to the 2026-09-11 Node 22/Vitest 4.1.11 baseline: current Node 24/Vitest 5.0.3 has 5,264 tests versus 3,748, and package source changed across many main commits. This is current-contract evidence, not a causal speedup or regression claim.
